chapter: Las Vegas, Sinatra and later years
title: Playing again at Dick Gibson's Denver festival
summary: Dick Gibson invited him to Denver as a guest; he played with Dick Hyman and a sextet with Teddy and Peanuts despite ringing in his ears.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: And Eve called me and said that Dick Gibson was calling from Denver, that I was supposed to play and I forgot to cancel the job, at (unintelligible) Garden. He had a festival going.

So, he said -- I told him I wasn't going to play and this that, I quit and he said, well, forget that, come as a guest. So I went as a guest and some band had been there and there was a vibraphone there, and they called and I went up

and said that -- Dick Hyman who had worked with me before, said "Dick, I have no idea that piano rumbles in my ears, I have no idea what's going to happen, and I'm scared." He said, Dick said, "Just play." Everybody around you has worked with you, and they're with you. So I played. And I tried to shut out things that would bother, and I got through, so the next night Teddy and Peanuts and Jack Lesberg and the drummer, we had a sextet and so Peanuts wanted me to do it. I said, "Oh, I don't think I should. I can mess you up."
And, I did it. And I think if I hadn't done it that quick after the operation I'd have never played.
And if you hadn't done it with a bunch of guys like that, that you were so used to that you knew well and they knew you well --
Yes, but I had a lot of funny sounds in my ears. I mean the --
Yeah, but you knew you didn't have to worry about those guys.
